title: Project Proposal
subtitle: A Clear Plan, One Accountable Team, And A Strong Finish
executiveSummary: Edited in Word for PRESSURE-099 — include accessibility coordination & field verification.
projectUnderstanding: Furnish 4 scopes for SYNTHETIC Municipal Garage 99.
approachIntroduction: The owner should always know where the project stands, what changed, and who owns the next move.

approachPhases.title: RIDE OR DIE
approachPhases.description: We keep drawings, bid coverage, owner operations, procurement, safety, schedule, and cost aligned and own the hard handoffs from the first decision through turnover.

approachPhases.title: NO BULLSHIT
approachPhases.description: We keep one current version of scope, cost, schedule, risk, and open decisions—and share changes early.

approachPhases.title: PROBLEM SOLVERS
approachPhases.description: Changes come with facts, options, ownership, and a recommended next move.

approachPhases.title: STAY HUNGRY
approachPhases.description: We challenge the plan and improve it as the team learns, through closeout and beyond.

scopeSections.title: General Conditions
scopeSections.description: Construction Management Fees; Transportation; Insurance; Temporary Utilities; Construction Facilities; Temporary Toilet; Construction Aids & PPE; Project Sign; Cleaning-Up; Overhead & Profit

scopeSections.title: Existing Conditions
scopeSections.description: Site Demolition; Structure Demolition; Select Demolition; Hazardous Material Remediation

designStartupServices.title: Geotechnical Services
designStartupServices.description: Borings and subsurface exploration; soil, rock and groundwater observations; bearing values; and fill, compaction and pavement recommendations.

designStartupServices.title: Architectural Services
designStartupServices.description: Programming, concepts and design development; code, life-safety and accessibility review; coordinated permit drawings; and plan-review responses.

designStartupServices.title: Structural Engineering
designStartupServices.description: Foundation and framing design criteria, calculations and details; delegated-component coordination; and structural permit responses.

designStartupServices.title: Civil And Site Engineering
designStartupServices.description: Survey coordination, site layout, grading, drainage and stormwater, utilities, erosion control, access, parking and agency submittals.

designStartupServices.title: MEP, Fire And Energy Engineering
designStartupServices.description: Mechanical, electrical, plumbing, fire-protection and energy-code design; utility loads; system coordination; and permit documents.

designStartupServices.title: Permitting And Municipality Coordination
designStartupServices.description: Pre-application, zoning, building, fire, utility and public-works meetings; applications; review comments; resubmittals; and other permit-driven consultants.

scheduleNarrative: The proposed timeline connects scope, design, procurement, field execution, inspections, owner decisions, and turnover.
exclusions: Hazardous-material testing or abatement unless it is specifically written into the scope.
Hidden conditions that could not reasonably be seen before work begins, and owner-requested changes after approval.
Anything not shown or written in this proposal, its scope, or the listed exhibits.
recommendationSteps: Review the remaining scope and basis questions together
Authorize preparation of the owner contract draft
Confirm the project team, start date, and notice-to-proceed requirements
